name: A Good Shout

perks.name: Mag-lev Rail
perks.desc:
Magnetic levitation massively decreases friction, allowing higher bolt velocity.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases persistence

perks.name: Empowered Rail
perks.desc:
Imbuing a rail with paracausal energy improves the durability and effect duration of bolts.
  •  Greatly increases persistence
  •  Decreases handling speed

perks.name: Ultralight Rail
perks.desc:
Lightweight rail construction makes it easier to handle.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Quickload Rail
perks.desc:
A streamlined rail speeds up operations.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Low-Profile Rail
perks.desc:
A pared-down rail improves weapon usability.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases persistence

perks.name: Frictionless Rail
perks.desc:
Reducing friction on the rail allows for faster loading and higher velocity.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Explosive Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts explode shortly after hitting the environment or a target, but deal less damage on impact.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Spring-Auger Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts release an impulse shortly after impact that deals a small amount of damage and has a high chance to cause flinch.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Charged Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts attached to targets deal damage over time.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Serrated Bolts
perks.desc:
Recovering a bolt from a living target deals damage.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Heavy Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts deal increased damage, but are slower and more affected by gravity.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Bolt Scavenger
perks.desc: Recovering a bolt increases reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Demoralize
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon increases reload speed and Sword charge rate and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Problem Solver
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

notes: Inspired by @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-SustainedDamage PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained Boss DPS against a single yellow-bar target as part of a weapon rotation in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. A Good Shout is a high-impact heavy bow which as a subfamily are rated A-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic as having very high potential ceiling for damage rotations with refill perks. The frame intrinsic provides a ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when stationary or moving less than 2.8m/s - crouch walking speed - as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are excellent by comparison with its peers - you can see at https://d2foundry.gg/w/3615748501 how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Use the rail perk to boost Handling, for faster swaps, and the bolt perk to improve damage. For sustained boss damage, you'll need a special weapon that does damage over time so you can proc Envious Arsenal to refill a bolt from reserves by swapping between this and your primary/ second special weapon. For damage, High Ground either provides ×1.25 damage for your feet being 2m or more higher than an enemy's lowest point, or up to ×3 stacks of escalating damage on kills for a max of ×1.25. Because you can retrieve your bolts from the target, you should have no problems with ammo, making sustained damage easier. You've got a choice of origin traits. You might be lucky and get the rare Accelerated Assault origin trait, which passively refills 10% of the magazine, and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within a 1.6s window. Otherwise there's Problem Solver, which is very good for PvE when facing yellow bars - 3 hits will apply Exhaust to an enemy, reducing damage output to ×0.9 for a refreshable 5s and grant +50 to Reload Speed and Handling for 10s (12s enhanced) - both effects are also refreshable. There's also Vanguard Vindication which provides up to ×3 stacks on kills within 20s of using a class ability that reduces incoming damage to a max ×0.94 for a refreshable 10s (12.5s enhanced). If you're interested, Sarpedon was a son of Zeus and Europa and king of Lycia, killed in the Trojan War. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

SpaceMonkey (PvE / God-PvE): "Not in love with the perk combos for this crossbow tbh. Withering Gaze is cool, but is it worth the heavy slot? Repulsor + Destab combo from the heavy slot is interesting, but worth it? And the lack of Autoloader is pretty sad. As part of a DPS rotation it should be good, but I'd prefer something that had a bit more general usage." Recommended MW: Reload.
